title: Worst-Case Discovery and Runtime Protection for RL-Based Network Controllers
abstract: arXiv:2605.04373v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: RL-based controllers achieve strong average-case performance in networking tasks such as congestion control and adaptive bitrate streaming. Yet their performance can degrade severely under network conditions where strong performance is still achievable. Identifying such conditions and quantifying the resulting performance gap is intractable by enumeration, while the sequential and closed-loop nature of RL controllers makes formal verification methods impractical.   We present ReGuard, a framework that discovers worst-case scenarios for a given RL controller and protects it against them at inference time without retraining. ReGuard formulates scenario discovery as a bilevel regret-maximization problem, certifying a lower bound on the controller's worst-case performance gap. ReGuard then analyzes the discovered counterfactual trajectories and compiles them into lightweight logic rules that intervene only when a risky state is det

translated_title: 基于强化学习的网络控制器的最坏情况发现与运行时保护
translated_abstract: 基于强化学习（RL）的控制器在拥塞控制和自适应比特率流媒体等网络任务中能够实现优异的平均情况性能。然而，在某些网络条件下，其性能可能严重退化，而这些条件本是可以取得良好性能的。通过枚举方式识别这类条件并量化由此产生的性能差距是不可行的，同时RL控制器的顺序性和闭环特性又使得形式化验证方法难以实际应用。我们提出了ReGuard，这是一个针对给定RL控制器发现最坏情况场景、并在推理时对其进行保护的框架，且无需重新训练。ReGuard将场景发现形式化为一个双层遗憾最大化问题，为控制器的最坏情况性能差距认证出一个下界。随后，ReGuard分析所发现的反事实轨迹，并将其编译为轻量级逻辑规则，仅在检测到危险状态时进行干预。
tldr: 提出了ReGuard框架，通过双层遗憾最大化问题发现强化学习网络控制器的最坏情况场景，并将反事实轨迹编译为轻量级逻辑规则，在推理时无需重新训练即可保护控制器。
en_tdlr: ReGuard discovers worst-case scenarios for RL-based network controllers via a bilevel regret-maximization problem, and compiles the discovered counterfactual trajectories into lightweight logic rules that protect the controller at inference time without retraining.
